Ye Zhang · MUSA 5500 + MUSA 6950 · Fall 2026

## The project

A state bill, HB 2186, would allow one accessory dwelling unit (ADU) on every home lot in Pennsylvania.
No one knows how many lots have room for one, or where one would pay off.
This project answers both, for the whole state.

- Is it allowed? Town rules today vs HB 2186
- Does it fit? MUSA 6950. AI on aerial images finds open yard space and trees
- Does it pay off? MUSA 5500. Population, jobs, rent, and building trends since 2010
- How many by 2031? Both halves together

[Open the tool](tool.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Two classes, one tool

| | MUSA 5500 | MUSA 6950 |
|---|---|---|
| Question | Is there demand, and does an ADU pay off? | Is there room on the lot? |
| Methods | APIs, spatial joins, K-means, zonal stats, OSMnx, random forest | U-Net, Random Forest, YOLO, a 600 sq ft fit rule |
| Code | `musa5500/` | `musa6950/` |
| Docs | [MUSA 5500 pages](musa5500/docs/data.md) | [MUSA 6950 pages](musa6950/docs/data.md) |

Each class has its own code and documentation. The tool reads results from both.
